url.description: Public http/https URL of the document (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, XLSM, XLSB, XLS, ODS, ODT, CSV, Apple Numbers, HTML, XML, Markdown, plain text, PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG; max 20971520 bytes). Use this OR file_base64.

file_base64.description: The file as base64 (data: URL prefix allowed, max 20971520 decoded bytes). Use this OR url.

filename.description: Optional: original filename with extension (needed for Office/OpenDocument files sent as base64, e.g. report.docx)

content_type.description: Optional: MIME type of the file when the filename has no extension

max_chars.description: Optional: cap on returned markdown characters, 1000-400000 (default 400000)
